description: GET /runs/{id}/files restarts stopped sandbox container of terminal runs: run_files.rs reconnect_run_sandbox() calls sandbox.activate() unconditionally; DockerSandbox::activate() docker-starts the container; nothing stops it -> one leaked running container per visited finished run. Same in handler/sandbox.rs list_sandbox_files and sessions.rs. Terminal WS activate is intentional.
resolution: Unresolved; seed fabro-52f2 carries fix options (checkpoint/final_patch for terminal runs, ref-counted auto-stop, or refuse activate on terminal runs; degraded final_patch path already proven viable)

description: GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/files calls reconnect_for_run() + sandbox.activate() (run_files.rs:1216-1220). DockerSandbox::activate() docker-starts a stopped run container (docker.rs:1663, ContainerStartAction::Start) to read workspace files. No production code path in fabro-server calls .stop() afterwards (zero .stop() call sites outside workflow-engine run finalization). Browsing the Files tab of a finished run resurrects its container permanently until manual docker rm or system prune. Observed 2026-08-21: runs 01M0GG56PQYP and 01M0GJVW659C stopped correctly ~1.4s after completion on 2026-08-20 (21:10Z/21:57Z), resurrected 08:04:35Z/08:05:52Z by web UI file inspection, stayed Up ~35min until manual docker rm. Tracked as seed fabro-284b.
resolution: Open: fix directions are (a) serve file listing from checkpoint git storage, (b) stop-after-read when inspection started the container, or (c) idle reaper for containers of terminal-state runs. Seed fabro-284b.

name: sandbox-inspection-lifecycle-ownership
description: Sandbox lifecycle ownership rule: Sandbox::activate() returns SandboxActivation::{AlreadyActive,Started}. Read-only inspection endpoints wrap the sandbox in an InspectionSandbox guard (run_files.rs) that stops it again via finish() only when activation==Started AND the run status is_terminal(); interactive endpoints (terminal, SSH, file PUT) intentionally keep resurrect-on-use. This prevents web-UI browsing of finished runs from leaking running containers forever (fixed fc6accada, seed fabro-284b). When adding new inspection endpoints, always use reconnect_run_sandbox_for_inspection + finish() on every exit path (including error and degraded-fallback branches).

name: runner-image-as-config-lab-validated
description: image.dockerfile = { path = ... } on provider=docker auto-builds fabro-runner-<sha12> with inspect-first reuse (fabro-969f, runs 01M0RAB7Z3S1DZ124Z8HQGHXPN cold 89.4s / 01M0RAFNKSW0MBT2C2WM6Z2CJG reuse 43ms, setup 899ms vs 24.5s mise). Lab form: .fabro/Dockerfile.mise with mise use -g (NOT mise install — shims need version defaults without a config file), tools mirrored from .mise.toml because the build context is empty.

Environments-API stored envs (image.docker) merge with project image.dockerfile of the same id -> both-set resolve error blocked every dockerfile run; Option::combine leaked the lower layer. CLI hides the cause behind 'failed to resolve manifest settings'.
resolution: EnvironmentImageLayer hand-implements Combine: higher layer setting either field suppresses the other (commit ea08ce4b8). Reproduce pattern: fabro-manifest build_run_manifest test over a stored-catalog EnvironmentLayer.

name: engine-condition-evaluation
description: Edge conditions: parser (fabro-graphviz condition.rs) accepts dotted keys + numeric ops (>= <= > <) natively; the EVALUATOR (fabro-workflow condition.rs lookup_flat) needed dotted-path object walking — literal key first (dotted user keys keep exact match), then decompose and walk nested JSON objects; context.-prefixed variant also resolves. Routing precedence: conditional edges > preferred_label on unconditional > unconditional. Exit-kind precedence: edge kind attr > exit-node kind attr > natural. HookContext carries context_updates (journal bridge, fabro-31b2) for stage_complete AND stage_failed; sandbox hooks get context via stdin (host) or FABRO_HOOK_CONTEXT file (sandboxed); scripts CANNOT read run context — read the tracker/sd instead.
